caption: Layer grouping patterns, where the horizontal and vertical axes represent groups (G_1, , G_4) and numbers of layers in groups.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the layer grouping patterns, with categories such as "Increasing," "Uniform," "Decreasing," "Spindle," and "Bottlenecked" displayed along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis is labeled "numbers of layers in groups" and has a linear scale ranging from 2 to 6, with tick labels at increments of 1. Each category has a single bar represented in a light green color. The shortest bar, corresponding to the "Bottlenecked" category, has an approximate height of 2 units. The tallest bar, corresponding to the "Increasing" category, has an approximate height of 5 units. The bars are sorted alphabetically by the category label. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlining.
